chief_decision: Lunar digger settled on four grouser skid wheels on folding arms, narrow 100 mm kerf chain loosener feeding wide bucket-ladder into 20 L steep wedge hopper run half-full, rear-pivot tilt plus screw metered pour over bin lip, camera teleoperation with heartbeat stop plus odometry-fiducial reset plus current-limit digging on 24 V 20 Ah fused bus in twin-tube frame. Leading digging end and trailing dump end fixed. Bench tests after build: BP-1 arching through 150 mm outlet with screw assist, cutting edge wear rate, bin fiducial visibility and align accuracy.
